What to Eat Near Ellora Caves

Regional food is one of the pleasures of a trip to this part of Maharashtra. This page introduces common dishes, not specific establishments or prices.

Google Maps ↗ ASI source listing ↗

Independent guide · Page reviewed 9 November 2026 · ASI listing consulted 2026-10-29

Kailasa Temple (Cave 16) is one monument within the UNESCO-listed Ellora Caves. Prices, opening status and routes are dated listings to re-check, not live confirmations.

Common dishes and formats

Maharashtrian menus range from quick street snacks to a full thali. Naming a dish is not a claim that any particular outlet near Verul serves it — check current menus locally.

  • Vada pav and misal pav: widely known savoury snacks built around bread and spiced preparations.
  • Pav bhaji and other griddle-cooked street dishes: commonly found across the region.
  • A Maharashtrian thali: a plated meal with several preparations, useful when you want one substantial sitting.
  • Bhakri with pithla or other accompaniments: a rustic millet-bread based meal.
  • Puran poli and other sweets: seasonal or festive preparations rather than everyday staples.
  • Chai: the most common short-break drink; see the cafés and refreshments page.

Eating around a monument visit

A heavy meal before walking a long, hot site is not always a good idea. Carry water, keep something light available, and plan a proper meal for after the visit or back in the city.

Dietary needs and spice levels vary; confirm ingredients directly with whoever prepares the food.

Reviewed 9 November 2026. Dish names are general regional vocabulary, not recommendations or availability claims.

Respect the protected property

Food and drink rules inside the ASI-managed Ellora Caves are set on site. Do not eat in restricted areas, and carry all litter out with you.

Frequently asked questions

What is a typical Maharashtrian meal?

A thali brings several preparations on one plate; snacks such as vada pav and misal pav are common lighter options. Availability near Verul must be checked locally.

Is vegetarian food easy to find?

Vegetarian preparations are common in the region, but this guide does not verify any specific outlet. Confirm dishes directly.

Are these dishes served at Ellora?

No claim of that is made here. This is a general introduction to regional food, not a listing of current vendors.
